NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Puts your logo in the bottom right corner of every picture in a folder, in one Run. The Math nodes work out the corner from each picture's own size, so pictures of different sizes all get the logo in the same place. For text instead of a logo, use 3. Watermark All Images in a Folder.

 Pick your folder

  1. On Load Images from Folder Pixaroma, click Browse and pick your folder, or paste the folder's path into the box.
  2. Click Pick images, then Select all, or click only the pictures you want. The button shows how many are picked.
  3. Press Run once. Leave the Run count at 1: the node sends every picture through by itself, one after the other.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Products inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 Your logo

  1. Click the picture on 2. your logo to upload your own logo. A PNG with a see-through background looks best. The demo uses the Pixaroma logo Logo.png from the Media Inputs folder.
  2. Bigger or smaller: open the gear on that node and change Longest side (160 px in the demo).
  3. Closer to or further from the edge: change 3. distance from the edge.

 Another corner

Change the two formulas. a = the picture's size, b = the logo's size, c = the distance from the edge:

Cornerx formulay formula
Bottom right (the demo)a - b - ca - b - c
Bottom leftca - b - c
Top righta - b - cc
Top leftcc
Centre(a - b) / 2(a - b) / 2

 A softer logo: make your PNG half see-through in your picture editor before you load it.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Folder not approved Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (1. your folder) - Point it at a folder and pick the pictures. Press Run once and every picture gets the logo, one after the other. Its resize is Off, so each picture keeps its own size. Its width and height go to the Math nodes.
  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (2. your logo, PNG) - Your logo, best as a PNG with a see-through background. Its gear is set to Longest side 160: the logo's longer side becomes 160 px. Change that number in the gear for a bigger or smaller logo.
  • Number Pixaroma (3. distance from the edge, px) - How far the logo sits from the right and bottom edges, in pixels.

 The helpers

Purple. They run by themselves and do the small jobs: count, pick, join or pass things along.

  • Image Info Pixaroma (the logo's size and see-through parts) - Reads the logo's finished width and height and its mask: which parts of the PNG are see-through.
  • InvertMask (show the logo, hide its background) - Turns the mask around, so the logo itself shows and its see-through background does not. Without it you would paste the empty background instead of the logo.
  • Math Expression (x = picture width - logo width - edge) - Works out where the logo starts from the left: a - b - c = the picture's width - the logo's width - the distance from the edge. It runs once PER picture, so a bigger picture still gets the logo in its corner.
  • Math Expression (y = picture height - logo height - edge) - The same from the top: the picture's height - the logo's height - the distance from the edge.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • Image Composite Masked (puts the logo on the picture) - Pastes the logo onto the picture at x and y, using the mask so only the logo shows. resize_source stays off: on, it would stretch the logo over the whole picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (keeps each picture's name) - Saves each picture as JPG into ComfyUI/output/With Logo, named like its picture with _logo at the end.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.
